user_confirmed: raw coefficients; TLCC -2..+2s at frame step; 4s windows every 1s; equal clip weighting
source_dataset: ViCo paper test43; excludes ood and training

extractor.coefficient_order: motion: exp[64],angle[3],trans[3]; complete raw coeff[257] retained
extractor.landmark: face-alignment 1.3.5; TWO_D; SFD; flip_input=False; first detected face
extractor.alignment: official align_img: y=H-1-y, target_size=224, rescale_factor=102; bicubic PIL
extractor.missing_landmark: previous valid landmarks forward-fill; initial missing: official lm3d 5-point fallback; all missing clip rejected
extractor.renderer: omitted: coefficient output is the ReconNetWrapper forward pass before rendering
extractor.precision: FP32; no autocast, no TF32; deterministic cuDNN; inference mode; eval mode
extractor.normalization: none; raw native coefficients; rotation radians; no degree conversion
extractor.identity: GT and prediction independently extracted with identical weights/preprocessing; no fitting prediction to GT

timing.alignment: exact equal frame counts; origin zero; no lag fitting or dynamic time warping
timing.generation: existing native 512x512/25FPS -> antialiased 256 -> nearest-time 30FPS score copies
timing.limitation: 25->30 nearest-time repeats frames and affects adjacent-frame and correlation metrics; native25 output retained in parent

metric_definitions.FD: mean absolute coordinate difference per clip; exp/angle/trans separately
metric_definitions.RTLCC: mean absolute difference of per-coordinate, per-lag Pearson curves of (speaker,GT) and (speaker,pred); positive lag listener later; overlap recentered per lag
metric_definitions.RWTLCC: RTLCC in complete 120-frame windows at starts 0,30,...; no padding; incomplete trailing window omitted; average windows then clips
metric_definitions.FID_fm: per-clip Gaussian Frechet squared distance; raw per-frame motion features; unbiased sample covariance ddof1; PSD symmetric eigensolver
metric_definitions.FID_delta_fm: same distance on consecutive frame differences, never across clip boundaries; no division by dt
metric_definitions.SND: FID_fm+FID_delta_fm on raw scale; before any display multipliers
metric_definitions.V_D: mean coordinate temporal population variance ddof0, then mean clips; report GT reference as well
metric_definitions.aggregation: equal clips, equal windows within each clip; exp64 and pose6 separately
metric_definitions.table_scale: FD and FID_delta_fm multiplied100; RTLCC/RWTLCC/SND/V_D unchanged; raw values retained

limitations: Not verified against unavailable CustomListener author scoring code/checkpoint/normalization
Correlation lags, strides, channel aggregation, constant handling and boundaries are explicit local choices approved by user
Rendered RGB re-extraction can differ from directly scoring a coefficient-generating model's native outputs
SND/variance/FID aggregation follow public definitions; exact author implementations not available
